name: Baked Zucchini Noodles with Turkey, Feta, Tomatoes, Olives & Basil

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 205°C (400°F). Line two baking sheet pans with aluminum foil for easier cleanup (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
9 medium zucchini squash
1 ½ small pkgs grape tomatoes
1 small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Trim zucchini, then run a vegetable peeler along the length of the zucchini to make ribbons. Divide between the baking sheets, drizzle with oil, and season with spices; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp oregano, dried
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, tossing halfway through, until zucchini is tender, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, halve grape tomatoes. Place in a medium bowl.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add turkey and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1.02 kg ground turkey
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, roughly chop olives. Add to the bowl with the tomatoes.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add half to the bowl. (Reserve remaining basil for serving.)
When the turkey is done, add tomatoes, olives, basil, tomato sauce, feta, and pine nuts to the pot. Stir to combine the sauce and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (213 ml) cans tomato sauce
1 ½ (113 g) pkgs crumbled feta cheese
¾ cup pine nuts

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide zucchini noodles between plates or bowls. Top with sauce and reserved basil. Enjoy!
